description: Update the either_of crate to remove its dependency on the ::std module for accessing the Error trait. Since the minimum supported Rust version (MSRV) is now 1.88, the Error trait is available in ::core, allowing us to eliminate the ::std import completely and make the crate more compatible with no_std environments.
functional_requirements: Remove all imports of `::std` from the either_of crate's source code
Ensure the crate continues to compile correctly with MSRV 1.88
Verify that the crate still passes all existing tests after the dependency removal
